title: scabiosa lusitanica
intro: Scabiosa lusitanica, commonly known as the Lusitanian scabious or narrowleaf scabious, is a perennial plant native to the Iberian Peninsula and North Africa, belonging to the honeysuckle family (Caprifoliaceae). The plant is rich in medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic agent. The therapeutic actions of Scabiosa lusitanica include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, contribute to its medicinal properties.
